answer: Because your father has passed away, a power of attorney won't work here, since a power of attorney ends when the person who signed it dies. The help center has a separate article called Selling a car you inherited, but it isn't available to me, so I can't tell you what paperwork you'll need. For that part, please contact a store. The general process starts with an online offer using the car's VIN or license plate, followed by an appraisal appointment, a roughly 30-minute inspection, and then signing the paperwork and getting paid.
